FAQ.title: Frequent <green>Questions</green>
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about WazzapAI

howItWorks.question: How does WazzapAI work?
howItWorks.answer: WazzapAI connects to your WhatsApp via QR code (like WhatsApp Web). Once connected, our AI analyzes incoming messages and generates personalized responses based on your instructions. Everything is automatic and real-time.

banRisk.question: Can WhatsApp ban me?
banRisk.answer: Our system uses Baileys, a proven solution imitating human behavior. By following best practices (response delays, personalization), the risk is minimal. Thousands of active users without issues.

freeTest.question: Can I test for free?
freeTest.answer: Absolutely! Create an account and get 10 free credits to test the platform. No credit card required. The trial period lasts 7 days. Without subscribing to a paid plan within that time, your account is automatically deleted. If you purchased credits during your trial, you get an additional 30-day grace period to subscribe.

credits.question: How does the credit system work?
credits.answer: 1 credit = 1 message sent by AI. Purchased credits are added to your subscription balance and cannot be used without an active subscription. When your plan expires, your credits are frozen for 30 days. If you renew within that period, they are restored and added to your new plan credits. Without renewal after 30 days, your account is permanently deleted.

multiNumber.question: Can I connect multiple WhatsApp agents?
multiNumber.answer: Yes! The number of agents depends on your plan. Starter: 1, Pro: 3, Business: 6, Scale: unlimited. Each agent has its own WhatsApp number, instructions and catalog.

appointments.question: How do I connect my WhatsApp number to an agent?
appointments.answer: From your agent's page in the dashboard, click Connect WhatsApp. Two options: scan the QR code from another device, or use an 8-character pairing code if you're on the same phone (WhatsApp → Settings → Linked Devices → Link a Device → Link with phone number). The agent is operational as soon as the connection is established.

security.question: Are my data secure?
security.answer: Absolutely. End-to-end encryption, sessions stored securely, and GDPR compliance. We never read your conversations.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, no commitment! Cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Upon expiry, all your agents are disabled and your credits are frozen. Renew within 30 days to get your credits back and reactivate your agents.

expiredSubscription.question: What happens when my paid subscription expires?
expiredSubscription.answer: Upon expiry, all your agents are disabled and your unused credits are frozen. You have 30 days to renew: if you do so before the deadline, your frozen credits are fully restored and added to your new plan credits, and your agents are reactivated immediately. Without renewal after 30 days, your account is permanently deleted.

retention.question: What happens after 30 days without renewal?
retention.answer: Your account is permanently deleted: profile, agents, order history, all data. This action is irreversible. You receive an email and push notification reminder before the deadline to give you time to act.

creditsOnly.question: Can I use WazzapAI without a subscription?
creditsOnly.answer: A subscription is required to access the platform. Credit packs are complementary: they add to your subscription balance when you need more. If you have purchased credits without a subscription, you have 30 days to subscribe and recover them.

whatsappBusiness.question: Does WazzapAI work with WhatsApp Business?
whatsappBusiness.answer: Yes! WazzapAI works with both regular WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business. Just scan the QR code from your phone to connect any account.

trainAI.question: Can I train the AI with my own information?
trainAI.answer: Absolutely! You can configure your agent with your products, prices, business hours and all information specific to your business. The AI uses this data to respond accurately to your customers.
